description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for articles in a C# ASP.NET Core application, including data models, validation, command handling, and database interactions for creating a new article including tag management.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object for article creation containing title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validator for article data ensuring required fields are not null or empty.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the article data for the create operation.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the create command, validating the contained article data.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the creation of a new article including author attribution, tag processing, and database persistence.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of creating an article, handling tags, and saving to the database.
